# Existing detector assets

`sourudra-model1.pt`, `sourudra-model2.pt` and `sourudra-another_model.pt` are pretrained detector assets supplied in the original project archive, used as alternatives by `backend/alpr_service.py` / `hardcase_ocr.py`.

The previous README named a reference repository without its URL, revision or license. Those details remain unverified; do not assert original training or public redistribution rights. See `docs/THIRD_PARTY_AND_CONTRIBUTIONS.md` and `docs/model-assets.json` for purpose, scope and SHA-256 inventory.
